goal: One costs.py (taker and maker, round trip and per side, slippage) imported by every study under backtest/ and research/, plus a test that greps those folders for fee/slippage literals and fails outside an allowlist. Today 57 of the 70 files that set a cost define their own constant (costs.csv imports_fees = 0) although fees.py:3 says none may.
note: From T06-F2 (S2, CONFIRMED, 2026-10-24). Forms in use: 10, 12, 14, 20 bp RT, 7 bp per side, 6 bp per fill, 0.09/0.14 % RT pairs. The same gross trade nets -0.10 % to -0.20 % depending on the file, so published net means are not comparable across studies. Do not re-run or restate any verdict: wire the module, keep each study's old constant beside the new one, and record the fee regime (A all-taker, B maker entry + taker exit, C all-maker, D Binance maker; T06 section 7) next to every verdict. Inventory: MyTradingSys/research/dsa_backtest_audit_2026-10-16/scripts/T06/costs.csv (test_cost_inventory.py guards it).
